datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Zimbabwe administrative boundaries. The data represents spatial classifications of acute food insecurity phases (IPC scenarios) for near-term projections in 2018, with multiple snapshots captured in February, June, and December.
